zec.interpretation: Still near the session's $1,000 area after the earlier breakout; no persistence failure and no new qualification event.

xmr.interpretation: Participation broadened, but no XMR-specific catalyst or abnormal volume acceleration was found; current move is still best treated as privacy-sector halo plus broad risk-on beta.

dash.interpretation: Below the earlier intraday acceleration; remains a high-beta privacy follower rather than a new leader.

ecosystem_scan.solana: Spot DEX volume remains down ~22.3% weekly; no displacement of Robinhood or privacy-sector leadership.
